source_instruction: i am looking for resealable snak club antioxidant trail mix. 5.5oz packs of six.
query: Ugh, I spent my whole walk over here replaying that last scene from the baking show I binged last night where the contestant got sent home just because their apricot tart had a soggy bottom, I still can’t believe they didn’t give them a second chance to crisp up the crust! I also stopped to pet the cutest calico cat curled up on the store’s welcome mat on my way in, it had a tiny little knit scarf around its neck that matched its orange patches perfectly, and I almost tripped over a stack of reusable shopping totes by the entrance because I was too busy cooing at it. I’m looking for dried fruits and raisins that come in a resealable bag, specifically the 1.37 pound pack of 1 option, and I don’t want anything that goes over what I’ve set aside for this.
